---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for the Urban Heat Mitigation Platform
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are requesting.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? What gap does it fill?

**Example:** "Currently, the platform only supports Landsat and Sentinel data. Urban planners in India also need access to ISRO Resourcesat-2 imagery for higher-resolution analysis."

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Be as specific as possible.

- What is the expected input?
- What is the expected output?
- How would users interact with this feature?
- What components would need to change? (API, ML engine, frontend, etc.)

## Alternative Approaches

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Target Users

Who would benefit from this feature?

- [ ] Urban planners / city officials
- [ ] Researchers / academics
- [ ] Environmental consultants
- [ ] Citizens / community groups
- [ ] Developers / integrators
- [ ] Other: _________

## Integration Points

Which platform components would this feature interact with?

- [ ] Satellite data acquisition (STAC / Bhuvan)
- [ ] Spectral indices computation
- [ ] LST retrieval
- [ ] UHI detection
- [ ] ML prediction engine
- [ ] XAI / SHAP explainability
- [ ] Recommendation / optimization engine
- [ ] Scenario simulation
- [ ] Dashboard / frontend
- [ ] Report generation
- [ ] API (new endpoint needed)
- [ ] Database (new schema needed)
- [ ] Other: _________

## Dependencies

Are there any external dependencies, APIs, libraries, or data sources required?

## Success Criteria

How would we know this feature is working? Define measurable success criteria.

- Example 1: "Users can upload Resourcesat-2 imagery and compute NDVI at 5.8m resolution within 60 seconds."
- Example 2: "Adding a new city takes less than 5 clicks and imagery auto-downloads."

## Mockups / Diagrams (optional)

If applicable, attach wireframes, mockups, or flow diagrams to illustrate the feature.

## Effort Estimate (optional)

- [ ] Small — A few hours of work, well-understood scope
- [ ] Medium — A few days of work, some research needed
- [ ] Large — A week or more, significant research or architectural changes
- [ ] Unknown — Needs further investigation

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request here.

---

**Thank you for helping us improve the Urban Heat Mitigation Platform!**
